The Casita Craze: Is Your Backyard Guesthouse Worth the Investment?

In Southern Arizona, a backyard casita can feel like the ultimate bonus: space for family, a home office, or potentially rental income.

By Reddy Appraisal LLCOctober 22, 20262 min read

IN THIS ARTICLE

Construction cost and value are differentWhat buyers pay for comparable featuresPlan around your budget and local requirementsMore in Home Improvements ↗← All 24 articles

THE SHORT ANSWER

Before investing in a casita in Tucson or Pima County, research the current local requirements, get realistic construction estimates, and compare nearby sales with accessory living space. The best project is one that fits both your lifestyle and your budget, even if the resale premium is smaller than expected.

Construction cost and value are different

In Southern Arizona, a backyard casita can feel like the ultimate bonus: space for family, a home office, or potentially rental income. With flexible living arrangements becoming more popular, it is tempting to assume that adding a guesthouse will increase your property value by exactly what it costs to build. Real estate rarely works that neatly.

What buyers pay for comparable features

An appraiser looks at what buyers in the local market actually pay for comparable properties with similar features. Size, quality, access, privacy, utility connections, and whether the casita is legally permitted can all influence its contribution to value. A detached guesthouse may appeal to one group of buyers and matter less to another. Rental potential can be attractive, but zoning, permits, and rental rules must be checked before making income assumptions.

Plan around your budget and local requirements

Before investing in a casita in Tucson or Pima County, research the current local requirements, get realistic construction estimates, and compare nearby sales with accessory living space. The best project is one that fits both your lifestyle and your budget, even if the resale premium is smaller than expected. A residential appraisal can help you better understand how the market treats these features.
